test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the following events during India's freedom struggle, chronologically :

I. The Salt March

II. Jallianwala Bagh Massacre

III. Quit India Movement 

IV. Non Cooperation Movement
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Jallianwala Bagh Massacre** occurred on April 13, 1919, where British troops under General Dyer fired upon a peaceful gathering, resulting in a significant number of deaths and injuries.
 
• **Non Cooperation Movement** was launched by Mahatma Gandhi in 1920 as a non-violent protest against British rule, urging Indians to boycott British goods and institutions.
 
• **The Salt March**, also known as the Dandi March, was initiated by Gandhi on March 12, 1930, as a non-violent protest against the British salt tax, covering a distance of 240 miles from Sabarmati Ashram to Dandi.
 
• **Quit India Movement** was launched by Mahatma Gandhi on August 8, 1942, calling for an end to British rule in India with the slogan "Do or Die".
